what: One full-size run of the delivery chain (tools/possession_deliver.py) with the default release configuration possession-release.json (possession-v2.15 first) on the synthetic rehearsal bundle of K003 with the invented Smart Tagging file of K011 (file names, record counts and slot counts of the provided files; content: corrupted Metrica sample games; an invented stretch before the second-half kick-off). The same bundle and options as run 1 of possession-v211k-rehearsal.json. Wiring and size check after the decision of K013, reporting only. Nothing here is from the provided match and nothing was selected with it.
environment: chain under Python 3.10.20 / numpy 1.26.4 / scipy 1.11.4 / pandas 2.1.4 (Linux, 2 CPUs); scoring under 3.13.18 / numpy 2.5.3 against stored labels (truth_stable.npz, the file-order Metrica proxy labels of K005; no label is recomputed)
options: --no-public-check --no-clone-check --quick (tests and cross-platform check included); simulated clock readings of K003
status_lines: [ 6] VERI ...................... OK (taktik VAR, yayin VAR, videolar YOK, smart tagging VAR)
[16] BELGE ..................... OK (Prova.md = teknik belge + calisma kaydi)

run_record_rows.System: possession-v2.15 (v2.11 on the graded windows; on the v2.1 path its probabilities are pooled with a temporal convolution network before the v2 decoder; Smart Tagging kick-off rule)
run_record_rows.Second model: used: the probabilities of the tree models were averaged with those of the temporal convolution network before the decoder
run_record_rows.Kick-off rule: a kick-off tag of the automatic Smart Tagging was used: the frames of a graded block before that tag are written D

limits: The bundle is two corrupted Metrica sample games laid out by us; one of them is game 3, which had been used in the development of v2.14 and v2.15. The scores are agreement with Metrica proxy labels on a synthetic layout; they are not competition scores and were not an input to any choice.
The Smart Tagging file is invented by us around kick-off frames we chose; it says nothing about the tags of the provided file.
The run used --quick: no repeat run, no run without clock readings, no fresh clone.
One machine (Linux). Whether the chain runs on the team's computer is checked there, by the team.
